_readme: Each persona is a realistic founder as they would actually fill in onboarding —
biggest_challenge is written the way a person types it (a sentence or two), NOT
reverse-engineered to match CHALLENGE_KEYWORDS. That is deliberate: the harness
must measure whether the engine understands real user language. Rewriting these
to make the scores go up would defeat the entire purpose of the fixture set.
expected_any_of = titles a thoughtful advisor would consider a correct top pick.
A hit means AT LEAST ONE expected title appears in the top N. Titles are matched
via canonical_title_key, so subtitle/edition variants collapse.
Every expected title must exist in the tagged canon (app/data/readar_canon_v1,

personas.label: Solo consultant undercharging on hourly work

payload.biggest_challenge: I keep undercharging. Every project turns into scope creep and I end up working nights for a flat fee I quoted months ago. I have no idea how to charge for value instead of hours.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Double my effective hourly rate without working more hours.

personas.label: Agency owner, business depends entirely on them

payload.biggest_challenge: The whole business depends on me. If I take a week off, everything stops. Nothing is documented and every decision routes through my inbox.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Take a month off without the business falling apart.

personas.label: Idea stage, has not validated demand

payload.biggest_challenge: I have an idea I am excited about but no evidence anyone actually wants it. I am scared of spending a year building something nobody needs.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Know for certain whether this is worth building.

expected_any_of: The Four Steps to the Epiphany

payload.biggest_challenge: People sign up and then vanish. Most never come back after the first week and I cannot work out what is going wrong in those first few days.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Get retention to a point where growth compounds instead of leaking.

payload.biggest_challenge: We picked our price out of thin air two years ago and never touched it since. I suspect we are leaving a lot of money on the table but I have no framework for changing it.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Re-price the product with actual confidence.

personas.label: B2B SaaS with founder-led, unrepeatable sales

payload.biggest_challenge: Every deal closes because I personally charmed someone. It is not a process, it is me. I tried hiring a rep and they sold nothing in four months.
payload.vision_6_12_months: A sales motion that works when I am not in the room.

payload.biggest_challenge: I have no reliable way to find clients. Everything so far has come from one friend who keeps referring me, and when he goes quiet I have nothing.
payload.vision_6_12_months: A predictable pipeline that does not depend on one person.

personas.label: Scaling founder now managing managers

payload.biggest_challenge: We went from 8 to 25 people in a year and I am now managing managers. I have never been taught how to lead at this size and I can feel things slipping.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Build a leadership layer I actually trust.

expected_any_of: The Hard Thing About Hard Things

personas.label: Profitable on paper but no cash in the bank

payload.biggest_challenge: My accountant says we are profitable but there is never any money in the account. I genuinely do not understand where it all goes each month.

expected_any_of: Simple Numbers, Straight Talk, Big Profits

personas.label: Burned out, doing everything at once

payload.biggest_challenge: I am completely burned out. Seventy hour weeks, twenty things half-finished, and I cannot tell what actually matters anymore. I am close to walking away.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Work less and get more of the right things done.

expected_any_of: It Doesn't Have to Be Crazy at Work

payload.biggest_challenge: We look identical to four competitors. Prospects cannot tell why we are different, so every deal collapses into a price argument we lose.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Be the obvious choice for a specific kind of buyer.

personas.label: Marketplace chicken-and-egg
personas.probes: RD-12: marketplace model gets no canon boost

payload.biggest_challenge: Classic chicken and egg. I cannot attract sellers without buyers and I cannot attract buyers without sellers, so both sides stay empty.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Get one side of the marketplace to critical mass.

personas.label: Ecommerce burning money on ad channels

payload.biggest_challenge: We have thrown money at Facebook, TikTok and influencers and none of it stuck. I am just guessing at channels and watching the budget drain.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Find one channel that reliably works and go deep.

personas.label: Idea stage, the blocker is the founder

payload.biggest_challenge: Honestly the thing holding me back is me. I keep procrastinating, I second-guess every decision, and some part of me is convinced I am not good enough to pull this off.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Actually start instead of researching forever.

expected_any_of: Mindset: The New Psychology of Success
So Good They Can't Ignore You

personas.label: Scaling product co. with a delivery bottleneck

payload.biggest_challenge: Orders come in faster than we can fulfil them. Delivery is the bottleneck, quality is slipping, and customers are starting to notice the delays.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Fulfilment that keeps up with demand without quality dropping.

personas.label: Cleaning company needs steady leads to retain cleaners
personas.probes: RD-11 owner-reported causal bottleneck; acquisition before generic sales or hiring

payload.biggest_challenge: I run a residential cleaning company. Inconsistent lead flow means I cannot fill cleaners schedules. They leave because their earnings are unreliable, so I spend all my time recruiting and cleaning instead of growing the business.
payload.vision_6_12_months: Grow profitably and hire someone to manage the cleaners

personas.label: Cleaning company needs profitable client volume
personas.probes: RD-11 September 21 screenshot challenge; specific evidence beyond broad sales/marketing

payload.biggest_challenge: Growing client volume profitably to fill subcontractor schedules while maintaining margins tight enough to reinvest in acquisition
payload.vision_6_12_months: Grow profitably and hire someone to manage the cleaners
